query: Fun-Control workflow fails in WanVideoSampler with tensor size mismatch (111 vs 110) during sampling.

desired.outcome: kijai diagnosed: an upstream node outputs a resolution not divisible by 16; resize the image after that node instead. OP confirmed "Thank you, it work."
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP A/B confirmed a settings-level workaround: switch the 'Patch Sage Attention KJ' mode to sageattn_qk_int8_pv_fp16_cuda and the same workflow runs cleanly — crash is specific to the SM89 FP8-PV kernel, which remains unfixed upstream.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Map an off-by-one tensor mismatch (111 vs 110) to Wan's latent dims needing divisibility by 16 and locate the upstream node emitting a non-conforming resolution.
